description: This file contains shell script code for configuring and managing NCM (Network Connection Management) protocol in OpenWrt. It defines initialization, setup, and teardown functions for the NCM protocol, handling device detection, modem initialization, network interface configuration, and error handling.

methods.name: proto_ncm_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration for the NCM protocol, setting default parameters and declaring configuration strings.

methods.name: proto_ncm_setup
methods.description: Sets up the NCM network interface, manages modem initialization, configuration, and network interface registration.

methods.name: proto_ncm_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the NCM network interface, retrieves modem info, and executes disconnection commands.
